name: Racing Car
description: Formula racing: A racing car manufactured in accordance with the formula stipulated in the vehicle rules issued by the International Automobile Federation (FIA) (including body structure, length and width, minimum weight, engine working volume, number of cylinders, fuel tank capacity, electronic equipment, tire distance and size, etc.) is a formula racing car, and the competition is a formula car race. The Formula One World Championship, referred to as F1, is the highest level competition in the formula car racing.
